description: Do the levels of two Workspaces over one file resolve independently when their calls interleave on one thread? Owner A = Workspaces(0) with DBEngine.OpenDatabase(main, writable); owner B = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own OpenDatabase(main, writable); one STA. A: BeginTrans; UPDATE Wide SET V = 100 WHERE ID = 1; BeginTrans; UPDATE Wide SET V = 200 WHERE ID = 2. B: CommitTrans (no level of its own); DBEngine.Errors; BeginTrans; UPDATE Wide SET V = 640 WHERE ID = 64. A: Rollback; DBEngine.Errors. B: CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. A: CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. Read Wide rows 1, 2 and 64 through each owner; close both; read them through a fresh Workspace. Statements use dbFailOnError.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
